text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short break for lunch. In the evening, I go to the gym or take a long walk in the park, because exercise helps me relax and stay healthy. Later, I have dinner, read a book, or watch a film. I try to follow this routine every day, because consistency gives me energy and keeps me focused.
